inclusions: Meals as per the package plan, including dinner on Days 1 and 2.
Private vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing as per the itinerary.
All intercity transfers between Madurai and Rameshwaram.
Driver allowance, fuel, toll taxes and parking charges.

days.title: Day 1 - Madurai to Rameshwaram
activities: Pickup from Madurai Airport or Railway Station.
Drive to the holy island of Rameshwaram (approximately 3-4 hours).
Arrive and check in to the hotel.
Stop at Pamban Bridge for photography and scenic views.
Visit Dhanushkodi and enjoy the coastal landscapes and sunset, subject to timing and weather conditions.
Dinner and overnight stay in Rameshwaram.

days.title: Day 2 - Rameshwaram Local Sightseeing
activities: Visit Kothandaramaswamy Temple, located in a scenic coastal setting.
Visit Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Memorial.
Explore the local markets for souvenirs, handicrafts and pearls.
Evening at leisure for beach walks or personal prayers.
Dinner and overnight stay in Rameshwaram.

days.title: Day 3 - Rameshwaram to Madurai
activities: Early morning check-out and drive to Madurai.
Visit Meenakshi Amman Temple for Darshan.
Explore the local markets, famous for Sungudi sarees and traditional handicrafts, subject to departure timings.
Transfer to Madurai Airport or Railway Station for your onward journey.
